stemMd: A 10 m by 6 m rectangular garden is surrounded on all sides by a 1 m-wide path. What is the area of the path alone?
explanationMd: The outer dimensions are 12 by 8 metres, giving area 96. Subtract the garden's 60 square metres to obtain 36 square metres of path.

distractorRationale.c: This is the garden area, excluding the path.
distractorRationale.d: This does not include the full outside dimensions and corner areas.
